title: Canon of the Unmaking Palm
summary: A canon on a palm that unmakes what it meets and strips the qi from guard and blow alike.

title: The Great Null Field Canon
summary: A canon on spreading the qi field wide and emptying it so that no technique of any kind takes shape inside it.

title: The Paired Voids Treatise
summary: A treatise on holding a void in each hand and crossing them so that what passes between is unmade.

title: A Dual-Track Absence Compendium
summary: A compendium on running two tracks of absence side by side so that one empties the guard and the other empties the foe.

title: Manual of the Sworn Silence
summary: A manual of the silence-sworn who give up every sound and every spark so that none can mark where they stand.

title: Treatise on the Unwalled Nothing
summary: A treatise on a nothing that has no walls and no end and that swallows the strength of foes and the foul air alike.
